title: The 7 new app/audio unit tests (r1 W2/W5 fix) are wired into NO gate — ci-local.sh and ci.yml run only `odin test core`
evidence: tools/ci-local.sh GATES: "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|odin test core" (the only test gate; gates 3/7 are `odin build app`, which excludes *_test.odin). .github/workflows/ci.yml:70: `run: odin test core`. The new tests exist (app/audio/audio_test.odin:15/34/53/72/90/116/140: test_consumer_crisis_draw, test_consumer_arrival_throttle, test_caption_crisis_priority, test_caption_expiry_and_reset, test_wav_pack_header, test_synth_wav_forms, test_variant_draws_stay_in_range) but no gate executes `odin test app/audio`.
detail: The claimed W2/W5 fix (7 unit tests) is real but unenforced: nothing in CI/local gates runs or even compiles the test file, so it can silently rot. The project's own rule pins invariants as durable gated tests.
recommended_fix: Add `odin test app/audio` to a ci-local.sh gate (e.g. fold into gate 2: `odin test core && odin test app/audio`) and mirror in ci.yml where the stock raylib links (mac leg; the container ships only the rlsw shadow).

title: Incomplete W6 fold: code comments still name Suno as the SFX slot source, contradicting the FINAL ruling (SFX = ElevenLabs) the README now carries
evidence: app/audio/audio.odin:19: "// Asset-drop contract (see assets/audio/README.md): drop Suno files at"; audio.odin:254: "// synthesized placeholder otherwise. The drop-in contract: dropping a Suno"; audio.odin:6: "// placeholder tones when real Suno assets are absent"; app/main.odin:204: "// (real Suno assets when present, synthesized placeholders otherwise;". But assets/audio/README.md:34-35: "- **SFX — the two stings in this contract (crisis alert + arrival click):\n  ElevenLabs.**" and README:36: "Music / ambience: Suno".
detail: The r1 supplier contradiction was fixed in the README, but five code comments still instruct dropping Suno files into the SFX slots — the same wrong-supplier trail in the module's own doc header. Anyone following the code comments generates SFX from the wrong source.
recommended_fix: Reword the Suno mentions in app/audio/audio.odin (lines 6, 19, 52, 254) and app/main.odin:204 to match the ruling: SFX slots = ElevenLabs; Suno = music only, or reference assets/audio/README.md as the single source.

title: Stale vacuous-guard comment after the W3 fold: harness comment still describes a "draws>0 check" that no longer exists
evidence: harness/run.odin:308-309: "// audio on == audio off (ODN-15). The draws>0 check (after the loop)\n\t// is the vacuous-guard: a no-op consumer would pass every hash trivially." — but the actual guard (run.odin:458-464) is per-kind: "// 7.2 vacuous-guards (r1 W3/W4)..." / "if audio_consumer.crisis_draws < 1 {"; no total-draws check remains. app/audio/audio.odin:95: "draws:            u64,   // cosmetic draws so far (the harness's vacuous-guard)" — the harness never reads `draws`.
detail: The W3 fold replaced the total-draws guard with per-kind counters but left the old description in place; a reader hunting the "draws>0 check" finds nothing, and the `draws` field's stated purpose is gone.
recommended_fix: Update run.odin:308-309 to describe the per-kind crisis_draws/arrival_draws/suppressed guards, and reword audio.odin:95's field comment (total draws is now only unit-test telemetry).
